scenario_meta.world_name: Luxury Cruise Storm Night 100-Agent Interaction Test
scenario_meta.description: A sealed luxury cruise ship during a severe storm night. Passengers, crew, entertainers, cooks, security staff, doctors, reporters, and mysterious guests must calm panic, exchange clues, repair equipment, organize shelter, treat seasickness, and handle escalating incidents without leaving the ship.
scenario_meta.simulation_objective: Run a 100-agent, 20-round closed-space storm escalation simulation with ordinary JSON actions first, LongLive only for physical rescue/cooperation actions, and image generation for lost jewels, damaged equipment, or strange ocean light artifacts.
